headline: First flight over the South Pole
post_facts: Four men in a Ford Trimotor
They dumped food to climb higher

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen twenty-nine... Richard Byrd's crew flew over the South Pole... the first ever.

scenes.label: Richard E. Byrd
scenes.caption: In his flight jacket, 1920s
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Four men flew from their base, Little America, in a Ford Trimotor.

scenes.label: hours there and back, almost
scenes.text: [calmly] The round trip took almost nineteen hours.

scenes.title: Too heavy to climb
scenes.text: [softly] To climb high enough, they threw bags of food overboard.

scenes.title: Made a rear admiral
scenes.text: [warmly] Back home, Byrd was made a rear admiral.

scenes.title: Would you have gone?
scenes.text: [gently] Would you have taken that flight?
